title: Process
description: The ISO 9001 §4.4 process object and the join point for the whole graph (Core Model §02, §10). Its apqc_code is the canonical key a KPI, a guardrail, and an agent binding for the same process all reference. Every field here is one an ISO auditor reads AND one an agent's guardrail check reads — the same object, not a parallel artifact. LOCKED for Phase 1.

id.description: Canonical id == apqc_code. The stable id other objects reference, independent of renames.

apqc_code.description: Position in the APQC Process Classification Framework. Equals id; carried explicitly so the join semantics are self-documenting.

owner_role.description: Single accountable owner (ISO 9001 §4.4). One role, never a team or list. A null owner is a flagged defect.

inputs.description: Typed data/artifact references, not free text — this is what makes conformance checking possible (§06).

kpi_refs.description: KPIs this process moves — and through them, the objectives above (§05 rollup path).

guardrail_ref.description: The Guardrail Policy governing any automated action in this process (§04). Inherited by every task unless the task overrides it.

version.description: Every change is a new version, never an overwrite (ISO 9001 §7.5).

typed_ref.description: A typed handle to a data object/artifact, e.g. {ref:'customer.kyc_doc', type:'document'}.
